title: Kubernetes client credentials
whyItMatters: Kubeconfig files and cached client certificates identify clusters and can carry bearer tokens that grant cluster access.
notes: Includes config and any cached plugin or token files. Cluster endpoints and certificates are not parsed.

cleanup.signOut: Remove this machine's user, token or client certificate in each cluster, so the kubeconfig cannot be used any more.
steps: Remove or rotate the credentials this machine used in each cluster.
Delete the folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Removes the cluster credentials from this PC. Tokens and client certificates held in the cluster keep working until they are removed there.
cleanup.source: Kubernetes, Organizing Cluster Access Using kubeconfig Files: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/organize-cluster-access-kubeconfig/
